description: Search a term over the last 24h, 7d or 30d (range, default 7d) without creating a keyword: each platform that can search back in time is read once (platforms to narrow; at most 25 results a platform) and every result is scored for relevance, sentiment and intents against the company profile, with kind (brand, competitor, topic: the default) and context telling the classifier what the term is. Results stay apart from the mentions: no alert, digest or report sees them. Billed $0.008 per scored result; the workspace must have topped up at least once (else funding_required) and the balance must cover the maximum (maxCostCents) (else insufficient_balance). At most 10 searches an hour. Returns the search queued: poll get_search until status is done (usually a minute or two), then read list_search_results.

context.description: A sentence the classifier reads for this search only, on top of the company profile: what the term means here, what to ignore.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

kind.description: What the term is to you, as on a keyword: brand (your company or product), competitor, or topic (the default). The classifier judges relevance with it.

platforms.description: The platforms to read; omit for every platform that can search a term back in time (bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, reddit, x, youtube, linkedin, tiktok, instagram, facebook). devto and news have no search and are reported as skipped.

range.description: How far back the search reads, ending now: 24h, 7d or 30d. Instagram reads at most its last 7 days whatever the range.

term.description: The word or phrase to search, case-insensitive, matched as the phrase (written joined or as a hashtag counts). Quotes are not needed.
